step3.description: Understand what's safe and what to watch out for in plain language

multilang.title: Multi-Language Support

risk.description: Clear color-coded risk levels help you quickly identify safe and potentially harmful ingredients.

smart.title: Smart Analysis
smart.description: Context-aware analysis tailored to product type — food, skincare, oral care, or cosmetics.

privacy.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.description: Your data stays private — images aren't stored on our servers. Analysis happens in real-time and results are only saved in your browser.
